thread:
Hugo: Heads up 10am lobby cameo: a raccoon is napping in the ficus pot. pic: https://i.imgur.com/bento-raccoon.jpg
Lily: Wait what. A raccoon? In the ficus? :raccoon:
Marcos: I nearly signed into the wrong laptop because Bento (yes someone named him) blinked at me like a tiny bandit. LOL
Hugo: He knocked over a recycle bin, sniffed a banana peel, then tucked into the soil and fell asleep. Very honorable loaf.
Lily: Is it safe? Should we call facilities or wildlife rescue? @facilities
facilities: Thanks for the report. Please do not approach. Facilities will dispatch a non-contact relocation team in ~20 minutes.
Marcos: He left muddy paw prints up the front steps. Evidence attached (two pics).
Hugo: @office-bot can we get a "do not feed wildlife" banner by the lobby? Also small sign for the ficus: "Occupied by Bento" :seedling:
office-bot: Request logged. Reminder: do not attempt to feed or handle wildlife. Facilities will coordinate with animal control if needed.
Lily: Petition to make Bento our new unofficial weekend mascot. I will draft a tiny slack emoji. :thumbsup:
Marcos: Agree but also note: Bento is a professional recycler. Give respect.
facilities: Update: Bento was gently encouraged out of the building using non-invasive measures and moved to a nearby tree line. No animals harmed. Please secure outdoor bins.
Hugo: Farewell Bento. May your raids be fruitful and your naps uninterrupted. (thumbs up gif)
